admin.m.clickjoin.web: Needs web analytics (GA4 / PostHog): a link click leaves no row in the database.
admin.mx.sub: Everything comes from real tables through admin RPCs (kpi_*). Templates always excluded; editorial excluded from creator metrics. n=0 shows as 0; nothing is padded or estimated.
admin.mx.pending: Migration supabase/migrations/0033_metrics.sql is not applied yet. Retention, funnel, virality and economy appear once it is; the counts above are already real.
admin.mx.retNote: "—" = cohort under 5 people, or that has not reached that day yet. D-N = did something exactly N days after signup (calendar day, Madrid time). In brackets: active / people who could already be measured.
admin.mx.f.invitee: Came invited and made a pick
admin.mx.pppHint: median {m} · {p} pools with participants out of {t}
admin.mx.ttsHint: creator sharing their own pool · n={n}
admin.mx.e.creator: Creator loop
admin.mx.notRecon: There is no Vinkos ledger. Not reconstructible and therefore absent: daily bonus, 4-hour drip, streak milestones and the historic signup amount. "rows" = sum of stored amounts; "rule" = real rows × current rule (signup per config, share 50, invitation 200+200 with daily cap and milestones, creator loop 25 up to 20 per pool, parimutuel payout). Payout windows use resolved_at, which exists since 0033.
admin.mx.def.active: Active on day D: made a pick, answered the daily pick, created a pool, shared with reward, collected an ad reward or the daily bonus (last day only). The database has no session log.
admin.mx.def.dau: DAU / WAU / MAU: people active that day / in the previous 7 / 30 days including the day. DAU/MAU = stickiness.
admin.mx.def.ret: Retention D1/D7/D30: % of the cohort active exactly 1/7/30 days after signup, only among those who already reached that day. Cohorts under 5 people show as "—".
admin.mx.def.funnel: Funnel: % over signups; medians in hours from signup to first pick or first pool. Repeat = 2nd user pool within 7 days of the 1st.
admin.mx.def.k: K-factor: validated invitees (came through a link and already made their first pick) divided by users. The link carries the handle, not the pool: there is no invitee→pool attribution.
admin.mx.def.ppp: Participants per pool: people other than the creator with a pick in each user pool (source=user; editorial and templates excluded).
admin.mx.def.tts: Time to share: hours from a creator publishing a pool to their first rewarded share of it.
admin.mx.def.clickjoin: Click → signup: not computed here. Needs web analytics (GA4 / PostHog) with consent.
admin.mx.def.economy: Economy: Vinkos are virtual points; they are never bought or exchanged for money. Faucets create Vinkos; sinks remove them; refunds and payouts only move what was already put in.
admin.mx.def.excl: Admin accounts: with "Exclude admin accounts" the team is left out of every count.
